children: Iambic Therapeutics, an AI-driven drug discovery company backed by Nvidia
, filed for a U.S. initial public offering on Monday, seeking to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker IAM.

The San Diego-based biotech said it plans to use the IPO proceeds and existing cash to advance three cancer drug candidates through clinical development, with the remaining funds earmarked for general corporate purposes.
The filing did not disclose an offering price range or number of shares, while Renaissance Capital reported a proposed deal size of up to $100M.
IAM1363, is an experimental oral HER2 inhibitor being evaluated in an early-stage Phase 1/1b trial for solid tumors. Two additional programs, IAM217 and IAM-C1, are in preclinical development.
Iambic, founded in 2019, uses AI and automated chemistry and biology to discover small-molecule drugs. It has raised about $461.8M from backers including Nvidia
, Qatar Investment Authority, Catalio, Nexus Ventures, and Coatue Management.
The company has collaborations with AbbVie
